materials.notes: Pinned WebKit build script downloads ICU 78.3 source. ICU official legal documentation describes binary distributions as including ICU/Unicode license and notes the requirement to preserve per-file notices when source is distributed.

materials.name: simdutf
materials.version_evidence: Exact WebKit commit's vendored Source/WTF/wtf/simdutf/simdutf_impl.h defines SIMDUTF_VERSION=9.0.0.
materials.notes: Bun's exact WebKit vendored header reports 9.0.0; Bun LICENSE.md lists Apache 2.0. Exact source version is established, but Bun source does not name the simdutf upstream tag/commit.
